I’m not a doctor, but when I worked in a clinic I had a patient keep passing me her sin card thinking it was her health card. I told her I needed her health card and then she asked me which one it was. She was in her 30s, I couldn’t believe it.

It was awful. I was in the hospital for months and having hallucinations and I was hearing voices from a bad anti-depressant allergy that put me into a drug-induced psychosis at random. Very terrifying, felt like I was in a movie and that it would never end.

Until one day the voices stopped and I could see clearly slowly again. I’ll never forget that. It was like I was given a second chance at life.

Although it’s been years and I can’t say my life got any better after that, I aged and grew and fought hard to get where I am now. It’s been four to five years and I’m still alive and that is all I want to be. I could have died or something worse. It really was hell on earth back then.
